title: Kenyan Beef Stew
description: A hearty, gluten-free stew from Kenya made with tender beef and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Kenyan Beef Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at African markets or online

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the chopped onion. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Kenyan Beef Spice Mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Return the browned beef to the pot and add the sliced red pepper.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over gluten-free rice or with gluten-free naan.
